issues.detail: The Greek 'αθανασιαν' (immortal/deathless) modifies 'φως' (light), but the Vietnamese translates it as 'sự bất tử' (immortality), which acts as a separate noun. The Greek says 'immortal light', not 'has immortality'.
The Greek 'οικων' (of the houses/homes) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
